title: Same Rank, Different Needs: Rethinking LoRA Redistribution in Federated Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.23742v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Federated low-rank adaptation (LoRA) enables clients with different resource budgets to collaboratively fine-tune foundation models. To distribute an aggregated update within each client's rank budget, existing methods commonly retain its leading singular directions. However, directions that best reconstruct the update matrix need not best preserve its responses on a particular client's inputs: a lower-energy direction may matter more to that recipient. We formalize this mismatch and show that matrix-optimal truncation can incur arbitrarily larger response error than another readout of the same rank. Motivated by this result, we propose Receiver-Aware Subspace Adaptation (RASA), a plug-in framework for receiver-aware knowledge transfer. RASA uses compact diagonal input second moments to perform uncentered PCA of receiver-weighted update responses. translated_title: 同秩不同需：重新思考联邦学习中的LoRA重分配
translated_abstract: 联邦低秩适配（LoRA）使具有不同资源预算的客户端能够协作微调基础模型。为了在每个客户端的秩预算内分配聚合更新，现有方法通常保留聚合更新的主要奇异方向。然而，最能重建更新矩阵的方向未必最能保留其在特定客户端输入上的响应：一个能量较低的方向可能对该接收方更为重要。我们形式化了这种失配现象，并证明矩阵最优截断可能比同一秩下的另一种读出方式产生任意大的响应误差。受此结果启发，我们提出了接收方感知子空间适配（RASA），一个面向接收方感知知识迁移的即插即用框架。RASA利用紧凑的对角输入二阶矩，对接收方加权更新响应进行无中心PCA。所得到的读出对于秩约束下的接收方目标函数是全局最优的，并且……
tldr: 该论文揭示联邦LoRA中按矩阵重构最优截断聚合更新可能无法保留其对单个客户端输入的响应，并提出了接收方感知子空间适配框架RASA，利用对角输入二阶矩对接收方加权更新响应进行无中心PCA，实现秩约束接收方目标下的全局最优读出。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that matrix-optimal truncation of aggregated updates in federated LoRA can fail to preserve responses on individual clients' inputs, and proposes RASA, a plug-in receiver-aware subspace adaptation framework that uses compact diagonal input second moments to perform uncentered PCA of receiver-weighted update responses, achieving globally optimal readouts under the rank-constrained receiver objective.
